about_the_game:
A Real-Time Strategy Roguelike in the Age of a Type II Civilization 🚀

Command a rising interstellar civilization, expand your influence, and master Type II technology in a dynamic real-time strategy roguelike.

Each decision shapes your odyssey—will you conquer, exploit powerful artifacts, or outmaneuver rivals through strategic mastery?

With roguelike mechanics, every playthrough presents new challenges, randomized upgrades, and evolving threats in a universe that never plays the same.

Key Features

🔹 Real-Time Galactic Conquest – Command fleets, capture territories, and engage in high-stakes battles in real time.

🔹 Roguelike Progression – Face procedurally generated challenges, randomized upgrades, and evolving threats with every run.

🔹 Harness Type II Technology – Unlock advancements like stellar engineering, quantum warfare, and Dyson sphere construction.

🔹 Relics & Power Artifacts – Discover cosmic artifacts that grant abilities and irreversible strategic consequences.

🔹 Tactical Warfare & Adaptive Strategy – Deploy powerful abilities like the Neutron Star Pulse for game-changing advantages.

🔹 Single-Player & Future Multiplayer – Battle adaptive AI or compete in strategic warfare (multiplayer may be added later).

Will your civilization thrive or vanish into the void? 🚀

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4160 / AMD FX-4300
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 / NVIDIA GeForce GT 710 / AMD Radeon R5
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 550 (2GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11

Conquer territories, harness advanced technology, and adapt to procedurally generated challenges. Deploy powerful abilities and shape the fate of your empire in an ever-changing galaxy. 🚀
